title: Multiple Server Holdings on One Harborline Account
content:
**Rule.** A customer may hold any number of servers in the VPS and Dedicated Servers range, each billed and renewed on its own term.

There is no maximum number of servers per customer: no figure caps the count, and the count of servers already held never bars another order.

## What follows from the rule

- Each server is its own holding with its own term start date, term end date and term length. For instance, a customer holding a Harborline VPS 4 GB on a 1-month term and a Harborline Dedicated Standard on a 24-month term has two separate terms, each billed and renewed on its own dates.
- One server's renewal is billed for that server only; holding a second server does not move or merge the first server's term.
- Servers of different tiers and of both server types, VPS and dedicated, may be held side by side on the same account.
